about.title: About
about.bio: Prof. Dr. Mian Muhammad Akram holds a Ph.D. in Economics with specialization in Islamic Economics. He is a retired Professor of Economics and former Principal of Government College of Science, Wahdat Road, Lahore (retired 14 October 2020). He continues to lecture on Islamic Economics at the University of the Punjab. He is co-author of the textbook "Islamic Economics" with Prof. Abdul Hameed Dar.
